name: popupPosition
description: Utility for positioning dropdown menus, popovers, tooltips, and other popup elements to ensure they remain within viewport boundaries.
features: Automatically flips popups to the opposite side when there's not enough space
Adjusts position to keep popups within viewport boundaries
Supports different placement options (top, right, bottom, left)
Supports different alignment options (start, center, end)
Calculates optimal transform origin for animations
Provides React hook for easy integration in components
usage: Use calculatePopupPosition() for imperative positioning of popup elements
Use usePopupPosition() hook in React components for declarative positioning
Use getPositionStyles() to convert position data to CSS styles
Set preferredPlacement to control initial popup direction relative to trigger
Set preferredAlignment to control alignment within the placement direction
Enable allowFlipping (default: true) to automatically flip when space constrained
Enable autoAdjust (default: true) to keep popups within viewport bounds

types.name: PopupPlacement
types.description: Direction to place the popup relative to the trigger element

types.name: PopupAlignment
types.description: Alignment of the popup within the placement direction

interfaces.name: PopupPosition
interfaces.description: Result object containing calculated position data

properties.name: preferredPlacement
properties.description: Preferred placement of popup relative to trigger

properties.name: preferredAlignment
properties.description: Preferred alignment within the placement direction

properties.name: viewportMargin
properties.description: Minimum distance (in pixels) from viewport edges

properties.name: allowFlipping
properties.description: Whether to flip to opposite side when space constrained

properties.name: autoAdjust
properties.description: Whether to adjust position to stay within viewport

properties.name: popupWidth
properties.description: Optional fixed width for calculations (if element not in DOM)

properties.name: popupHeight
properties.description: Optional fixed height for calculations (if element not in DOM)

properties.name: offset
properties.description: Gap between trigger and popup (in pixels)

functions.name: calculatePopupPosition
functions.signature: function calculatePopupPosition(triggerElement: HTMLElement, popupElement?: HTMLElement | null, config?: PositionConfig): PopupPosition
functions.description: Calculates the optimal position for a popup element relative to its trigger, accounting for viewport boundaries and configuration options.

parameters.name: triggerElement
parameters.description: The element that triggers the popup (button, input, etc.)

parameters.name: popupElement
parameters.description: The popup element to position (for size measurements)

functions.returns: PopupPosition object containing placement, alignment, transformOrigin, x, and y

functions.name: getPositionStyles
functions.description: Converts a PopupPosition object into CSS styles that can be applied to an element.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position data calculated by calculatePopupPosition

functions.returns: CSS styles object with position, left, top, and transformOrigin properties

functions.name: usePopupPosition
functions.signature: function usePopupPosition(triggerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>, popupRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>, config?: PositionConfig): React.CSSProperties | null
functions.description: React hook for calculating and applying popup positioning in components. Returns null if triggerRef is not available.
functions.returns: CSS styles object to apply to the popup element, or null if trigger not available

considerations: Uses getBoundingClientRect() to determine element positions, which accounts for scrolling and absolute positioning
For optimal results, ensure trigger elements have a defined size and position before calculation
Calculations include viewport dimensions, so popups reposition correctly even at screen edges
Does not handle scrolling events automatically - recalculation may be needed on scroll
For dynamic content, you may need to recalculate position after content changes size
Used internally by DateInput, Select, Tooltip, and other popup-based components
